sara_sales: FYI — MarinerBio exec just pushed for production by EOD next Thurs. They said remaining blockers are BYO KMS, VPC peering approval, and a hard pricing cap from procurement. Need a short exec bridge to confirm tradeoffs and owners.
alan_se: Ack. Do we have an inventory of what's missing for BYO KMS? I can sketch an integration checklist if someone confirms the KMS provider.
maria_eng: We tested OK with AWS KMS and Azure KeyVault. BYO KMS for their on-prem HSM will need a cert handshake + small change to keywrap flow. Rough estimate: 3 engineering days for validation + ops runbook.
sara_sales: They said HSM vendor is ThaliosSec — asks for attestations and an architecture diagram. Carmen, any blockers from security questionnaires?
carmen_cso: Security questionnaire 80% done. We flagged a request for HSM attestation and audit log retention (13 months) — waiting on their legal to send formal attestation. If they can give the attestation PDF we can close that item.
rachel_csm: I'm locking in a 30m call with their CTO tomorrow 10am PT to go over network and compliance. Will invite Eng + Security.
vince_re: Pricing note from procurement: they need a hard monthly spend cap and a rollback to a cheaper model if we breach it. Sales needs an approval for a capped committed invoice and a reserved capacity discount. What discount band do we have for 12-mo reserved?
alan_se: For Dedicated reserved 12-mo we typically offer 18-22% depending on GPU tier. We can also do a temporary credit model during POC. I'll DM finance for the exact band.
sara_sales: Action items: 1) Maria validate ThaliosSec HSM handshake feasibility (owner: maria_eng) 2) Carmen to request formal attestation PDF from MarinerBio legal 3) Alan to confirm discount band and quick pricing play for POC 4) Rachel to run the exec call and capture network checklist.
maria_eng: Starting an internal validation ticket. Quick note: if BYO HSM requires offline key import we'll need extra validation but can do a bypass for initial POC with KMS proxy in the VPC.
devops-bot: Runbook link: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/poc-byo-kms — use step 4 for VPC peering checklist.
carmen_cso: If they can't provide the attestation we can use our SOC2 + an extra contractual attestation clause for the pilot, legal ok pending.
vince_re: I'll prep two offer letters: A) monthly cap + overage alerting + automatic fallback to open model (lower cost) B) committed reserved with 12-mo term at discount band. Which does sales want to present?
sara_sales: Present both. Execs want flexibility — show A as default, B as option for lower unit cost. Also highlight our rollback + SLA on latency.
alan_se: Quick technical Q for call: do they require private endpoints (no NAT) or are they okay with egress through our peering? Need to confirm to size infra.
rachel_csm: On call invite I asked them to confirm network topology (private endpoints vs NAT). I'll push for the topology diagram before the call.
maria_eng: If they need private endpoints we should pre-warm a dedicated node pool in their region — adds ~24h infra lead time.
sara_sales: Noted. Meeting scheduled for tomorrow 10am PT. I'll create an internal bridge if anyone wants to join early. Please update the ticket with progress before 9am PT. :thumbsup:
